purpose: Distinguish retained-history readability from outcome-reader bottleneck; no policy repair is assumed.
normalization: FIT-only per-coordinate mean and population standard deviation, floor1e-4; no CHECK fitting or label-dependent feature transforms.

probes.state: New matched linear512-to4 exact-state probe on frozen final memory for all12 saved policies; initial probe weights shared acrossarms for a seed.
probes.outcome: Ours only: new128-tanh outcome head on frozen final memory plus frozen existing query summaries; same600 full-batch steps.

data: Original13 FIT families/6houses and12 CHECK families/2houses; previously exposed. Whole-family split unchanged, UNKNOWN masks retained, no new simulator data.
selection: All three seeds, fixed600 final updates; no checkpoint or hyperparameter search.
interpretation: Diagnostic CPU head updates only. Probe cannot feed actions, change saved policies, prove trained memory writing, or count as navigation/method benefit.
decision: If exact state is readable but original crossed reader fails, investigate reader/optimization. If neither probe decodes old state, investigate frozen features and causal memory writing; a negative probe does not prove information absence.
